properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated May 30, [1949], on stationery from the Gloucester Hotel in Hong Kong; includes description of attempts to meet with Mayor Lapham in Tokyo; meeting with Ki Chun and Alli [Ernest Allison], Max Polin and Bondy [William L. Bond], [C.A.T.?], C.Y. Liu; attempts to meet with the Director of Communications; meeting with Whitey Willauer; mentions Violette Chun.
